name: clinic_portal
description: Patient portal spec vs design. Heavy vocabulary mismatch (SMS vs text message, inactivity vs idle), conflicts on timings, and missing items sitting next to related text (uploads without malware scanning, a vague privacy line for HIPAA).

requirements.text: The portal must send an appointment reminder by SMS 24 hours before the visit.
requirements.evidence: A text message is sent to the patient the day before

requirements.text: Patients must be able to cancel an appointment up to 2 hours before its start time.
requirements.evidence: Cancellations are allowed until midnight on the day before

requirements.text: The system must synchronise doctors' availability from the clinic scheduling system every 5 minutes.
The system must log users out automatically after 20 minutes of inactivity.
requirements.evidence: Idle sessions are terminated after 20 minutes

requirements.text: The portal must support two-factor authentication using an authenticator app.
requirements.evidence: second login step using a one-time code

requirements.text: The system must record all access to medical records in an audit trail retained for 6 years.
requirements.evidence: opens a patient chart, the event is logged

requirements.text: The system must comply with HIPAA.
requirements.note: 'industry best practices for privacy' is a vague distractor

requirements.text: The system must scan uploaded documents for malware before storing them.
requirements.note: uploads are described but scanning is not

requirements.text: The system must make lab results visible to patients within 48 hours of being finalised.
The portal must be usable on screens as narrow as 320 pixels.
